description: Book a visit for an estimate option, optionally dispatching technicians to it. This sets the estimate's schedule and moves its work status to scheduled. notify controls whether Housecall Pro tells the customer; it defaults to false here, and on one measured account the call sent nothing either way. That is one account's configuration and not a promise: Housecall Pro's own automations and reminders can send independently, and it may still remind the customer as the date approaches.

arrival_window_in_minutes.description: Arrival window. Housecall Pro accepts only 0, 15, 20, 60, 120, 180 or 240

notify.description: Tell the customer. Defaults to false - say so explicitly to send

name: hcp_schedule_estimate_option
